about_the_game:
You run an old, second-hand electronics recycling shop, buying up discarded phones, laptops, and tablets. On the surface, it’s just a dull little business—but beneath it lurks countless irresistible temptations…

Some people forget to delete their personal files. Some try to hide secrets they never want revealed. You are the one who holds the key to unlocking them all. Will you quietly profit from this knowledge, or use it to push them step by step into submission? When she is out of options, when she fears exposure, when she can no longer resist your demands… how much choice does she really have left?

This is not just a simple buy-and-sell business. It’s a transaction fueled by money, desire, and control. The value of information is beyond your imagination—once you unlock the files, there’s no turning back…

🎮 Game Features

🔹 Information is power—Dig deep into digital secrets and hold their past in your hands.

🔹 Transactions are never simple—When she refuses your price, perhaps another "offer" will make up the difference…

🔹 Step-by-step submission—Watch them change from hesitant and fearful to completely unable to resist.

🔹 Multiple routes, multiple choices—Dominate or seduce? Your decisions shape her fate.

🔹 Intense, alluring H-scenes—Detailed performances, seductive voice acting—every "trade" will leave a lasting impression.

💋 Are you ready to dive into this forbidden game?

A battle of temptation and control awaits. With enough secrets in your hands, her fate is yours to decide…

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is not suitable for all ages.

All characters depicted in the game are adults.
The game contains adult themes, including female nudity and sexual content, mild violence, and non-consensual sex.
Please be aware of this content and ensure you are in an appropriate environment before playing to avoid causing discomfort to others.
